name: claude-master-dev
description: The marketplace of claude-master: add it with `claude plugin marketplace add frsorrentino/claude-master`, then `claude plugin install claude-master@claude-master-dev`.

plugins.name: claude-master
plugins.description: Run many Claude Code sessions on one machine: launch them in the right folder and account, in tmux, with a terminal window whose tab tells you which is which; list, close, restart, talk to them and restore them after a reboot. Configurable per machine, generic across terminals.
